title: XCR-Bench: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on cross-cultural reasoning tasks (CSI Identification, Prediction, and Adaptation) using the XCR-Bench dataset to measure how well LLMs handle and adapt Western Culture-Specific Items (CSIs) to non-Western contexts (Arabic, Chinese, and Bengali).

Comparing CSI adaptation performance and qualitative lexical choices between two regional and ethno-religious variants of the same language (Bengali for West Bengal/Hindu vs. Bangladesh/Muslim) using BERTScore metrics and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
